exercises.name: Dumbbell Row

source_english.description: Dumbbell Row uses one arm at a time with the opposite hand and knee supported on a bench.
instructions: Place the left hand and left knee on a flat bench, keep the right foot on the floor, and hold a dumbbell in the right hand.
Let the right arm hang under the shoulder, then pull the elbow toward the right ribs.
Pause with the back flat and shoulder away from the ear.
Lower the dumbbell until the arm is straight, then switch sides.
source_english.safety_note: Use a stable bench and a dumbbell that does not twist the supported torso.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Dumbbell)

source_english.description: A dumbbell hip thrust uses a dumbbell across the hips while the shoulders rest on a bench and the glutes drive the hips upward.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, knees bent, and feet flat.
Place one dumbbell securely across the crease of your hips and hold it steady.
Press through both feet to raise your hips until your torso is level with your thighs.
Pause with the glutes contracted, then lower the weight and hips under control.
form_cues: Center and pad the dumbbell on the hips.
Use a full, comfortable hip-extension range.
common_mistakes: Letting the weight roll toward the abdomen.
Driving through one leg more than the other.
source_english.safety_note: Use a manageable load and keep both hands on the dumbbell so it cannot shift.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Dumbbell)

source_english.description: Seated bent forward with dumbbells hanging below the shoulders, the rear-delt reverse fly raises the arms out and back through a controlled arc.
instructions: Sit at the edge of a bench with feet flat, hinge forward until the chest is near the thighs, and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Let the dumbbells hang beneath the shoulders with palms facing each other and a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they align with the upper back without lifting the chest.
Pause briefly, then lower the dumbbells slowly to the hanging position.
source_english.safety_note: Use light resistance and stop if the shoulder cannot move smoothly.

exercises.name: Good Morning (Barbell)

exercises.name: Deadlift (Barbell)

source_english.description: Deadlift (Barbell) hinges to the barbell, drives the floor away, and finishes with the hips tall before reversing the hinge.
instructions: Stand with the barbell over the mid-foot and hinge to grip it.
Brace the trunk, keep the back neutral, and push the floor away.
Extend the hips and knees until standing tall without leaning back.
Hinge first to lower the load and reset each repetition.
form_cues: Keep the shoulders over the bar or weights.
Finish with glutes, not lumbar extension.
source_english.safety_note: Use a load that allows a neutral spine from setup through lockout.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)

source_english.description: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell) hinges the hips back with the weight close to the legs until the hamstrings stretch, then stands by driving the hips forward.
instructions: Stand with the barbell at the thighs, feet hip-width apart, and knees softly bent.
Push the hips back while lowering the bar close to the legs with a neutral spine.
Stop when the hamstrings are stretched without losing the hinge position.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall, then repeat.
form_cues: Drive the hips forward to stand.
source_english.safety_note: Keep the load manageable and stop if you cannot maintain a neutral back.
